To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the proposed system achieves state of the art performance for product recognition in store shelves, and 2) the system can be used to recognize new products/packages in a seamless fashion, without requiring any additional training.

a) deep learning based global descriptors can be successfully used to recognize products on store shelves, b) the use of an image embedding loss during training is essential to obtain accurate global descriptors, and c) a deep learning pipeline can be successfully applied to product recognition on store shelfs.

a) the proposed system achieves state-of-the-art performance on the publicly available Grocery Product dataset; b) the proposed system is able to recognize new products/packages that have not been seen before during training; c) the proposed system can be used to perform real-time recognition of products on shelves.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following contributions: (i) a novel deep learning pipeline for fast and accurate product recognition on store shelfs, (ii) the first public dataset of reference and query images for the product recognition task.
